about: ThrusterChain's exact optimal reference controller (the best possible 100-step plan from each bank start) and the regret of saved controllers against it. Evaluator work only: no learner trained, no BCA band fitted. Exploratory; changes nothing in v6/v7.

definitions.discounted_value: sum_{t=0}^{999} 0.98^t r_t (truth.value, horizon 1,000), first 200 starts per bank
definitions.peak_deviation: per start, the largest |s_t| over t = 0..99, then mean (or max) over the bank
definitions.regret: optimum minus controller (return or points); >= 0 start by start
definitions.tracking_cost: sum_t |s_t|^2 over t = 0..99 (how far the floats are from rest)
definitions.worst5_mean: mean return of the worst 5% of starts

nonconvex.optimiser: scipy L-BFGS-B, ftol 1e-16, gtol 1e-12, at most 5000 iterations
